cookie.policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.policy.body:
This page explains which cookies and similar technologies are used on vonostudio.com. The data controller is VONO MİMARLIK TASARIM İNŞAAT.

What is a cookie?
Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. Local storage similarly keeps small pieces of information in your browser.

Which cookies do we use?
This site uses no advertising, marketing or visitor tracking (analytics) cookies. Only records strictly necessary for the site to work are used, and - with your permission - Google Maps in the contact section. The table below lists them.

Consent and changing your choice:
The map does not load until you allow it. You can change your choice or withdraw your consent at any time from the “Cookie preferences” link at the bottom of the page. Google cookies already placed can be deleted in your browser settings.

Third parties:
Google’s cookies are governed by Google’s own policy: https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies

Contact us:
For questions about your personal data and your rights under Article 11 of Law No. 6698, write to info@vonostudio.com.
